topic.title: 낚시하러 가기
topic.description: 주말에 친구와 낚시를 가기로 계획하는 대화입니다.

korean_scripts.korean_text: 주말에 낚시 갈 생각인데, 시간 괜찮아?
오, 정말 재밌겠다! 어디로 갈지 생각해 봤어?
공원 근처 호수로 갈까 생각 중이야. 낚시 장비 가지고 있어?
응, 낚싯대랑 릴 있어. 몇 시에 만날까?
오전 9시쯤 어때? 간식도 좀 챙겨야 할 것 같아.
좋아! 샌드위치 좀 싸갈게. 정말 기대돼.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: I was thinking about going fishing this weekend, are you free?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: I was thinking about going fishing this weekend, | are you free?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Oh, that sounds fun! Where were you thinking of going?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Oh, that sounds fun! | Where were you thinking of going?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: I was considering the lake near the park. Do you have any fishing gear?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: I was considering the lake near the park. | Do you have any fishing gear?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Yes, I have a rod and reel. What time should we meet?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Yes, I have a rod and reel. | What time should we meet?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: How about around 9 AM? We should also bring some snacks.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: How about around 9 AM? | We should also bring some snacks.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Great! I'll pack some sandwiches. I'm really looking forward to it.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Great! | I'll pack some sandwiches. | I'm really looking forward to it.
